# Code of Conduct

We expect participants to be respectful, constructive, inclusive, and focused
on the work. Harassment, discrimination, threats, doxxing, sexualized conduct,
and deliberately disruptive behavior are not acceptable.

Maintainers may edit, remove, reject, or restrict participation when necessary
to protect the community.

Use the project security or moderation contact for sensitive reports. Do not post private data or vulnerabilities in public issues.
